scope: mask-only independent review; no generated H&E was available or used

decisions.reason: This is the sole candidate passing all frozen hard gates. The significant immune transition is spatially coherent, with complete contained nuclei and preserved protected structures.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The 85,316-pixel joint change forms connected authorized stroma-to-immune regions; its 78,124-pixel tissue component is inside the nominal significant interval and preserves adjacent non-target compartments.
decisions.nucleus_layout: The 103 class-2 nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Source-relative area-p95, count, NND and Ripley ratios are 0.906, 1.308, 0.903 and 1.074.
decisions.coupling: Added immune nuclei remain inside authorized changed tissue; quota, seam, compatibility, distribution and density checks pass with score 0.890.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and support-exterior instances remain unchanged without partial-instance, overlap or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: The target population is more numerous, denser and has smaller nuclei than source, although within the frozen significant envelope. Mask-only evidence does not establish generated-H&E quality or clinical validity; both U1 targets for this patient abstained.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 01 as the single mask-condition handoff, retaining the population-density limitation.
